title: SQLMemberLookup member search applies the caller's Mondrian role member access and the result limit

criteria.given: a level annotated SQLMemberLookup is searched through OlapMetaExplorer.getAllMembers
criteria.then: each SQL hit is resolved through the role-applied cube and dropped when the caller's role cannot see it

criteria.given: the same search with a limit
criteria.then: the number of returned members is clamped to the limit
